subject: Re: potluck stuff
text: Hey! I just got home and the potluck sign-up sheet is still a total mess. Sorry for ghosting the thread, I thought I’d sort it out last night and then got roped into helping a neighbour fix a dripping tap. Anyway, I’ve finally got the list in one place, so I’ll shoot you the link once I’ve tidied the names and dietary notes. Can you nudge folks who haven’t replied? I’ll be at the park after six to check the picnic spots and maybe test that wobbly table. Bring the extension cord too? The last one chewed up our playlist, and I’m not repeating that saga.
